cohort: 224 neonates with Enterobacteriaceae BSIs admitted to a neonatal intensive care unit between 1 January 2015 and 30 April 2022
finding: Prior to more than two kinds of antibiotics use, Quick Sequential Organ Failure Assessment score > 2, pneumonia and caesarean section were independent risk factors for CRE BSIs.
